decisions: FunctionBlockFields and FunctionGenericFields are generated shared part-order rules; their diagnostic domain labels are not fields.
Managed production PublicDeclarationFields calls the corresponding PartFields suppliers.
SLG must supply actual parsed block input/result types and the primary3 generic names/primary constraint tuple, selecting order only from the supplied shared rule.
Preserve empty fields, inferred names and prior declaration hashes; no extra nested tuple domain.
Reversed rules reverse fields, relabeled rules preserve fields, unavailable parts reject with no silent omission.
remainingCallbackDecision: Additional callback-role interface metadata must be inspected and implemented as needed; this unit does not qualify it.
